prompt: On 12 August the database was unreachable for 22 minutes and every request to /entries/:id failed. /health returned 200 the whole time, the pipeline's post-deploy watch stayed green, and the automatic rollback never fired. Fix that. Keep the existing API and keep the pipeline's watch and rollback.

assertions.description: The handler exercises the database the service depends on
A non-2xx path exists and sits behind a branch
A failing dependency is reported, not thrown out of the handler
The response identifies which dependency failed
The existing API is not lost to the change
The pipeline still watches health and still rolls back
